source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 7 iulie — «Sfântul Cuvios Toma din Maleon»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 7ης Ιουλίου — «Όσιος Θωμάς ο εν Μαλεώ»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 7 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and gives the same man and the same mountain. The page carries no asterisk and not the «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence, but it doubts itself in its own words — «Οι πληροφορίες που έχουμε για τον Όσιο Θωμά είναι λίγες και μη επιβεβαιωμένες», and it offers two versions of his century: the thirteenth or fourteenth, because a soldier of such glory could not have acted after the fall of Constantinople, or the tenth, according to the diptychs of the Church of Greece. No `dates` are written for that reason and the two versions are reported instead. Part of his relics, it says, is in the metropolis of Monemvasia and Sparta.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).

hymns.text: Întru tine, părinte, cu osârdie s-a mântuit cel după chip; că luând crucea ai urmat lui Hristos; şi lucrând ai învăţat să nu se uite la trup, că este trecător; ci să poarte grijă de suflet, de lucrul cel nemuritor. Pentru aceasta şi cu îngerii împreună se bucură, Preacuvioase Părinte Toma, duhul tău.

source.text: doxologia.ro, «Troparul Sfântului Cuvios Toma din Maleon», Glasul 8

english.text: In you, father, what was made after the image was saved with diligence; for taking up the cross you followed Christ, and by your labour you taught us to look past the flesh, which passes away, and to care for the soul, which is a thing immortal. Therefore your spirit rejoices together with the angels, most venerable father Thomas.
